limitations: Three normal forms and two boss body variants, not ten or fifty unique designs.
Body Attack is a single lunge/thrust. Directional ground spikes, high attacks and kicked stones remain runtime pattern/VFX; dedicated anatomy for each direction is not included.
World heights are recommendations for integration; no Unity camera or runtime test was run by this package author.
Eight playback samples can contain genuine generated holds; unique pixel-frame counts are reported rather than claiming eight unique key poses.
checks: All production frames same native canvas as their canonical.
All selected frames binary alpha 0/255 and at most10 opaque colors.
Production copies match their selected original PNG bytes.
Common per-actor pivot and referenceHeight, no per-frame rescale or trim.
No selected opaque pixel touches a canvas edge.
